The '''Dead Eye Prototype''' was an experimental [[Spice/Legends|drug]] developed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under [[Project Dead Eye]]. It was specifically designed to improve the accuracy of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].

==Characteristics==
When injected, a dosage of the prototype drug would increase the user's accuracy for a brief period of time.
